brief: Holds the five rules a fault tree is judged by: one top, gates with two inputs, leaves with a probability, developed events, no event its own cause.
detail: Check takes the rule graph of a tree (AsRuleGraph) and answers the findings. A tree asks for this through its own GovernanceFindings, so a rule set is built by hand only to add a rule of your own or to run the rules on a graph.
